sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The goal is to fill all the grids with the matching blocks, keeping the gameboard from getting overcrowded. With no color matching required, you'll focus on strategic placement of blocks to clear the board and progress to the next level.

The game's core mechanics are deceptively simple, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels.
